messages:
Sam: heads up — CI turned red on main after the constraints sync earlier. Multiple aws integ tests failing, looks related to async client errors.

CI Bot: Build: linux-integration-aws #1234
Status: FAILED
Failed tests:
- tests/integration/aws/test_s3_upload.py::test_retries
- tests/integration/aws/test_async_client.py::test_head_object_async
Logs: https://ci.company.internal/builds/1234

Marta: link up, thanks. Are these flakes or consistent failures?

Evan: I reproduced locally after regen: poetry.lock shows botocore bumped to 1.30.0 which pulls aiobotocore 2.x. Async client stacktrace shows AttributeError in asyncio transport layer — suspicious mismatch.

Priya: can someone run a quick git bisect across the commits that touched constraints? I can if you give the range.

Sam: here's what I ran:
```
git checkout main
git bisect start
git bisect bad main
git bisect good v2026-03-01
# run test suite in the CI image
```

Evan: bisect landed on commit 5a1b2c3 — constraints/constraints.txt: botocore 1.29.5 -> 1.30.0 and poetry.lock updated. Repro steps attached in branch ev/bisect-botocore.

Marta: ok, quick mitigation: pin aiobotocore<2.0 in constraints to keep the async client behavior stable. Or pin botocore==1.29.5 until we can test aiobotocore 2.x.

Priya: I'll open a tiny PR that pins aiobotocore<2.0 and adds a smoke job to catch this class of failures in the post-merge pipeline. @Marta could you review?

Sam: great—assigning @Marta. If CI on that branch is green we'll merge and backport to the constraints branch. :thumbsup:

CI Bot: Re-run on pr/ev-pin-aiobotocore — BUILD PASSED
https://ci.company.internal/builds/1240

Sam: merging the pin now, will follow up with a postmortem note in #postmortems if needed.
